name: Scribeable - EHR Integration
_comment_key: PINS THE EXTENSION ID to glhmbeccefpambijlkfelcpkcbanlllf, the Chrome Web Store identity. This is the CWS PUBLIC key (not a secret) and it is here because an UNPACKED build otherwise derives its id from the absolute load path -- so the same source loaded from a git worktree gets a different id, lands outside the backend CORS allowlist, and every /api/auth/verify is blocked. The symptom is a successful Firebase sign-in followed by 'Couldn't verify your session', which looks nothing like a CORS problem. Chrome ignores this field when installing from the Web Store.
description: Seamlessly transfer clinical notes from Scribeable to your EHR system with advanced detection and field mapping
